thag4.4:1.1: A curse on bodies— full of foul smells,
thag4.4:1.3: where nine streams are always flowing.
thag4.4:2.3: who don’t delight even in heaven,
thag4.4:2.4: to say nothing of the human realm.
thag4.4:3.2: with bad advisers, cloaked in delusion:
thag4.4:3.3: Those sorts of people delight there
thag4.4:3.4: in the snare that Māra’s thrown down.
thag4.4:4.1: Whereas those dispassionate for passion, aversion, ignorance
